newsitem.title: USA: UPS FILES TO BLOCK STRIKERS' INTERFERENCE.
newsitem.headline: UPS FILES TO BLOCK STRIKERS' INTERFERENCE.

text.p: United Parcel Service filed in federal courts in Massachusetts, California and other states for an injuction seeking to prevent striking workers from interfering with company operations, officials said Thursday.

Motions were filed in a U.S. District Court in Boston, another court in Ontario, Calif., and in other areas where workers have tried to block business operations, UPS spokeswoman Jennifer Jiles confirmed.
"Quite frankly in a number of different areas, they have been impeding our ability to do business," she said.
At least 15 striking workers have been arrested and several have been injured, including a police officer, in clashes at UPS facilities in the Boston area in recent days.
Jiles said workers have tried to block working employees from entering facilities and delivery trucks from leaving at plants in Boston and Ontario, California and elsewhere.

"There are other areas dispersed sporadically around the country where there have been incidents," she said. "They have been doing things like lying down on the road. For their own safety, we are doing this," she added.
